mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_warehouse (warehouse_id, tenant_id, code, name, country_code, created_at) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{countryCode}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT warehouse_id, tenant_id, code, name, country_code, created_at FROM wms_warehouse WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_inventory_balance (tenant_id, warehouse_id, seller_sku, on_hand, reserved, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{warehouseId}, #{sellerSku}, #{onHand}, #{reserved}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, warehouse_id, seller_sku, on_hand, reserved, updated_at FROM wms_inventory_balance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY seller_sku
SELECT tenant_id, warehouse_id, seller_sku, on_hand, reserved, updated_at FROM wms_inventory_balance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND seller_sku = #{sellerSku} ORDER BY warehouse_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_warehouse_location (location_id, tenant_id, warehouse_id, zone_code, aisle, rack, shelf, bin, barcode, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{locationId}, #{tenantId}, #{warehouseId}, #{zoneCode}, #{aisle}, #{rack}, #{shelf}, #{bin}, #{barcode}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT location_id, tenant_id, warehouse_id, zone_code, aisle, rack, shelf, bin, barcode, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM wms_warehouse_location WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY zone_code, aisle, rack, shelf, bin
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_stock_check (check_id, tenant_id, warehouse_id, check_type, status, scheduled_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{checkId}, #{tenantId}, #{warehouseId}, #{checkType}, #{status}, #{scheduledAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT check_id, tenant_id, warehouse_id, check_type, status, scheduled_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM wms_stock_check WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_stock_check_line (check_id, tenant_id, seller_sku, location_id, system_qty, actual_qty, diff_qty, status, created_at) VALUES (#{checkId}, #{tenantId}, #{sellerSku}, #{locationId}, #{systemQty}, #{actualQty}, #{diffQty}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_stock_check_line SET seller_sku = #{sellerSku}, location_id = #{locationId}, system_qty = #{systemQty}, actual_qty = #{actualQty}, diff_qty = #{diffQty}, status = #{status} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND check_id = #{checkId}
mapper.select: SELECT check_id, tenant_id, seller_sku, location_id, system_qty, actual_qty, diff_qty, status, created_at FROM wms_stock_check_line WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND check_id = #{checkId} ORDER BY created_at FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_inventory_prediction (prediction_id, tenant_id, warehouse_id, seller_sku, predicted_demand, predicted_days_of_supply, recommended_restock_qty, confidence, model_version, prediction_date, horizon_days, created_at) VALUES (#{predictionId}, #{tenantId}, #{warehouseId}, #{sellerSku}, #{predictedDemand}, #{predictedDaysOfSupply}, #{recommendedRestockQty}, #{confidence}, #{modelVersion}, #{predictionDate}, #{horizonDays}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT prediction_id, tenant_id, warehouse_id, seller_sku, predicted_demand, predicted_days_of_supply, recommended_restock_qty, confidence, model_version, prediction_date, horizon_days, created_at FROM wms_inventory_prediction WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY prediction_date DESC
